title: Smart-Home & Tech-Ready Features Buyers Filter For
excerpt: EV chargers, whole-home automation, high-speed fiber readiness, and energy-monitoring systems appear more frequently in buyer filters.
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “smart home Austin for sale”, “homes with EV charger Austin”, and “tech ready houses Central Texas” want a local, practical answer.

EV chargers, whole-home automation, high-speed fiber readiness, and energy-monitoring systems appear more frequently in buyer filters.

New construction often includes these as standard or low-cost options; existing homes with documented upgrades (owned solar, recent HVAC with smart thermostats, structured wiring) attract attention.

Sellers: Highlight verified smart features and provide utility-bill history when available.

Buyers: Confirm ownership status of any leased solar or security systems before relying on them in the offer.

These features rarely justify large premiums alone, but they help a home stand out in a competitive showing schedule.
